quote: Each House shall be the Judge of the Elections, Returns and Qualifications of its own Members
summary: Each House must judge the elections, returns, and qualifications of its members

quote: a Majority of each shall constitute a Quorum to do Business
summary: A majority of each House constitutes a quorum to do business

quote: a smaller Number may adjourn from day to day
summary: A smaller number than a majority may adjourn from day to day

quote: may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members
summary: A smaller number may be authorized to compel the attendance of absent members

quote: in such Manner, and under such Penalties as each House may provide
summary: Compulsion of absent members must follow the manner and penalties provided by each House
applies_to: may be authorized to compel the Attendance of absent Members

summary: Each House may provide the manner and penalties for compelling attendance

quote: Each House may determine the Rules of its Proceedings
summary: Each House may determine the rules of its proceedings

quote: punish its Members for disorderly Behaviour
summary: Each House may punish its members for disorderly behavior
Each House may expel a member

quote: with the Concurrence of two thirds
summary: Expelling a member requires the concurrence of two-thirds

quote: Each House shall keep a Journal of its Proceedings
summary: Each House must keep a journal of its proceedings

quote: from time to time publish the same
summary: Each House must publish its journal from time to time

quote: excepting such Parts as may in their Judgment require Secrecy
summary: Parts that require secrecy in their judgment are exempt from publication
applies_to: from time to time publish the same

quote: the Yeas and Nays of the Members of either House on any question shall, at the Desire of one fifth of those Present, be entered on the Journal
summary: The yeas and nays of members on any question must be entered on the journal upon request

quote: at the Desire of one fifth of those Present
summary: Entering yeas and nays requires the desire of one-fifth of those present
applies_to: the Yeas and Nays of the Members of either House on any question shall, at the Desire of one fifth of those Present, be entered on the Journal

quote: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days
summary: Neither House may adjourn for more than three days during session without the other House's consent
The adjournment limitation applies during the session of Congress
applies_to: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days

quote: without the Consent of the other
summary: Consent of the other House is required to adjourn for more than three days
applies_to: Neither House, during the Session of Congress, shall, without the Consent of the other, adjourn for more than three days

quote: nor to any other Place than that in which the two Houses shall be sitting
summary: Neither House may adjourn to any other place than where the two Houses are sitting
